description: Semantic probes for the public parallel orientation fan-direction contract.

mutants.test_filter: Parallel fan orientation aims an exposed slope toward the configured cooling axis
mutants.description: Reversing the selected horizontal direction must fail the independently derived asymmetric-slope alignment assertion, without producing a degenerate direction.

mutants.test_filter: Parallel fan orientation keeps the configured axis for a symmetric solid
mutants.description: The symmetric fallback must preserve the configured fan axis when the exposed-overhang score has no directional preference.
